turns.content: Identify the hydrogen emission transition corresponding to n=2 to n=1.
Write the Rydberg wavenumber expression using R_H=109677 cm^-1.
For the remaining calculation, replace n_upper=2 by n_upper=3.
Identify the spectral series from the lower quantum number and name the line.
Check that emission releases positive photon energy and that the wavenumber is three quarters of R_H.
Evaluate and report the wavenumber in cm^-1 with the series classification.
